lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Simone Russo is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Simone is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d40: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d40: 🕯️ Simone Russo is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Simone kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Simone's gone." Marcus looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Simone." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Pablo blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Simone Russo, 40 days. The mantle passes to Pablo Aragón.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Pablo Aragón, 39 — a postal worker. His hands know different work now: Beast-calm.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Simone — and Simone is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Chloe, Marcus, Terry and 4 more speak for Pablo — "Simone trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Pablo before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
